notes.title: V 1.1
notes.content:
V1.1

Fixed : 

 Issue with the "delete building" button, which causes the first building to be deleted rather than the one you selected.
 Issues with research lab and shop : You couldn't buy researched buildings and where you couldn't buy a research lab when you removed the first one.
 Issue with music where the last instrument would sound off
 Issue where you couldn't unlock some achievement
 Issue where you couldn't buy certain buildings one researched.
 Typo on tutorial



Improved :

 Research Tab : A new button have been added to ease the research process.
 Upgrades ToolTip : Upgrades effects will be displayed next to the button.
 Filters : You can now filter your buildings.
 Swapped buildings and peoples on the assignement tab to make it feel more natural
 Added a bush in the tutorial to make scrolling more visual
 Slight QoL on the shop view to make decoration more visible
 Money is now visible while shopping/managing people



Out Now !
Sorry for the inconvenience.
